memberdef.name: EpilogueVectorizerEpilogueLoop

briefdescription.para: Implements the interface for creating a vectorized skeleton using the epilogue loop strategy (ie the second pass of vplan execution).

detaileddescription.para: This function is partially responsible for generating the control flow depicted in https://llvm.org/docs/Vectorizers.html#epilogue-vectorization.

briefdescription.para: Emits an iteration count bypass check after the main vector loop has finished to see if there are any iterations left to execute by either the vector epilogue or the scalar epilogue.
Allow subclasses to override and print debug traces before/after vplan execution, when trace information is requested.
